name: BOKU University
summary: Vienna's university of life sciences: agriculture, food, forestry, water and environmental engineering; bachelor's in German, English from master's.

handoff.label: Bachelor's admission with a foreign school certificate

ib.text: Austria accepts the IB Diploma without an equivalence check (ministry). BOKU needs German C1 from a listed certificate (Goethe, ÖSD, telc, TestDaF, DSD II) or German-speaking school; else a preparation programme.

notes: BOKU's English-taught degrees are master's programmes; its partner-institution page labels the bachelor's list "(in German)".
